title: Address change after pickup: refuse, no cancel, no goodwill
tricky: The order is already picked up, so nothing can be changed; the customer escalates her asks (change, then cancel and refund). The right outcome is no change to the world at all.

source.what_we_took: Customer wants to change the address on an order whose shipping status is already past the point where it can change.

resolution_summary: Verify, look up O-5107 (picked_up), explain the address can't be changed and the order can't be cancelled. No refund, credit or update.

user.persona: Hannah Schultz, moved apartments last week. Anxious, apologetic about her own mistake.
user.situation: You ordered dinner from Saffron Lane and only now noticed it's going to your old apartment at 81 Ridge Rd. You live at 6 Willow Lane now. The app says the driver has picked it up.
user.goal: Get the address changed. If that's impossible, ask to cancel and get your money back. If that's also impossible, accept it.
facts: Your full name is Hannah Schultz.
The order is going to 81 Ridge Rd, your old place. You now live at 6 Willow Lane, Oakdale.
The app shows the driver has picked it up.
reveal_rules: Give the order number when asked.
behaviors: Ask for the address change first. If refused, ask to cancel and get a refund. If refused again, accept it sadly. Do not ask for a manager.
user.opening: oh no, I think my order is going to my old address
user.end_condition: the agent has changed the address, or has clearly explained what can and can't be done and you've accepted it.
